research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Caris Life Sciences is researching genomic profiling similarity and next-generation molecular profiling to link comprehensive molecular data with treatment response and biomarker signatures in cancer. It develops systems for molecular profiling of tumors and genomic stability profiling to guide individualized medical intervention. The company also advances dual-modality models for digital pathology, dynamic tissue typing, accurate detection of origin of cell-free nucleic acids, and machine learning for multi-cancer metastasis risk, focusing on molecular profiling, AI, and precision oncology.

overview_description.description: Caris Life Sciences develops molecular profiling and AI-driven technologies to support precision medicine in oncology. The company offers a comprehensive tumor profiling service known as Caris Molecular Intelligence, which analyzes DNA, RNA, and proteins to help oncologists identify potential treatment options. Caris also operates a platform called Caris CODEai that integrates molecular data with clinical outcomes to support research and drug development. Its services cater to biopharma partners, healthcare providers, and academic institutions aiming to improve cancer diagnostics and therapy selection. The company incorporates machine learning models to discover new biomarkers and therapeutic targets based on large-scale multi-omic data.

about_short_description.short_description: Caris Life Sciences develops molecular profiling and AI-driven technologies to support precision medicine in oncology.

product.name: MI Cancer Seek®
product.description: A comprehensive tumor-tissue profiling test that uses simultaneous Whole Exome Sequencing and Whole Transcriptome Sequencing to characterize cancer biology and inform treatment decisions.

product.name: Caris Detect™
product.description: A blood-based multi-cancer early detection test that uses whole-genome and whole-transcriptome analysis with AI to identify cancer signals across multiple cancer types.

product.name: Caris Assure®
product.description: A liquid biopsy that analyzes plasma and buffy coat from whole blood to provide a broader molecular profile and help distinguish tumor-derived alterations from incidental findings.

product.name: Caris MI Clarity™
product.description: An AI-based prognostic test for HR-positive, HER2-negative, node-negative early-stage breast cancer that estimates early and late distant recurrence risk from H&E slides and clinical inputs.

product.name: Caris ChromoSeq™
product.description: A whole-genome sequencing assay for myeloid malignancies that consolidates genomic testing to support diagnosis, risk stratification and treatment decisions.

product.name: MI Profile®
product.description: An international tumor-tissue profiling test that assesses DNA, RNA and proteins to provide molecular information for individualized oncology treatment decisions.
